verses.pali: “Himavantaṁ, bhikkhave, pabbatarājaṁ nissāya mahāsālā tīhi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhanti.
verses.english: “Mendicants, great sal trees grow in three ways supported by the Himalayas, the king of mountains.

verses.pali: Sākhāpattapalāsena vaḍḍhanti, tacapapaṭikāya vaḍḍhanti, pheggusārena vaḍḍhanti.
verses.english: The branches, leaves, and foliage; the bark and shoots; and the softwood and heartwood.

verses.pali: Himavantaṁ, bhikkhave, pabbatarājaṁ nissāya mahāsālā imāhi tīhi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhanti.
verses.english: Great sal trees grow in these three ways supported by the Himalayas, the king of mountains.

verses.pali: Evamevaṁ kho, bhikkhave, saddhaṁ kulapatiṁ nissāya anto jano tīhi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhati.
verses.english: In the same way, a family grows in three ways supported by a family head with faith.

verses.pali: Saddhāya vaḍḍhati, sīlena vaḍḍhati, paññāya vaḍḍhati.
Saddhaṁ, bhikkhave, kulapatiṁ nissāya anto jano imāhi tīhi vaḍḍhīhi vaḍḍhatīti.
verses.english: A family grows in these three ways supported by a family head with faith.
